name: @shepherdjerred/the-storm
description: Turbo shim over the Gradle build of The Storm's Paper plugin (plugin/) — scripts wrap Gradle so the workspace joins the task graph (caching + affected). Same pattern as the Go and Rust shims. tests/e2e is the TypeScript real-server harness.

scripts.test: mise exec -- gradle -p plugin test --console=plain && bun --no-install --bun vitest --config ../../vitest.config.ts run tests/rcon.test.ts
scripts.lint: mise exec -- gradle -p plugin spotlessCheck pmdMain pmdTest --console=plain && bunx --no-install eslint --cache .
scripts.typecheck: mise exec -- gradle -p plugin compileJava compileTestJava --console=plain && PATH=node_modules/@typescript/native/bin:$PATH tsc --noEmit
